scripts.db:smoke: dotenv -e ../../.env -- node scripts/as-owner.mjs db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file tests/schema_smoke.sql
scripts.db:smoke:test: dotenv -e ../../.env -- node scripts/as-owner.mjs --target=test db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file tests/schema_smoke.sql
scripts.db:pull: dotenv -e ../../.env -- node scripts/as-owner.mjs db pull && prisma format
scripts.db:diff: dotenv -e ../../.env -- node scripts/as-owner.mjs migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code
scripts.test: echo 'schema tests run via pnpm db:smoke against a live database' && exit 0
